name: Docklet (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted VPS control panel for Docker app deployment, PostgreSQL management, reverse proxy, domains and server monitoring; no software subscription fee or stated usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own VPS/server, Docker 24+, Docker Compose 2+, domain/DNS for public apps and open ports; VPS, storage, bandwidth and optional NVIDIA AI API costs are not included. Protect privileged Docker and database access.
